q_gram_c2_01_001.question: A mí ___ que no tienen razón. (parecer, stylistic inversion for emphasis)
q_gram_c2_01_001.explanation: In Spanish, fronting indirect object pronoun с 'mí' creates emphasis на speaker's opinion. The verb 'parecer' agrees с implied subject (clause 'que no tienen razón'), taking third-person единственного числа: 'me parece'.
q_gram_c2_01_001.hint: The subject 'parecer' is entire clause который follows, не 'yo'

q_gram_c2_01_002.question: Fue en París ___ nos conocimos por primera vez. (cleft sentence particle)
q_gram_c2_01_002.explanation: This является cleft sentence (oración hendida) used для emphasis: 'Fue en París donde...' emphasizes location. When focused element является place, 'donde' используется. If it were time, 'cuando' would be used; для other elements, 'que' is more common. Some speakers accept 'que' here too, но 'donde' is stylistically precise choice.
q_gram_c2_01_002.hint: The focused element является place (en París)

q_gram_c2_01_003.question: What stylistic effect does placing verb before subject produce в Spanish declarative sentences (e.g., 'Llegó Juan' vs. 'Juan llegó')?
q_gram_c2_01_003.correct: It presents the subject as new or unexpected information (rhematic focus), giving the sentence a more narrative or dramatic tone
wrong: It makes the sentence grammatically more formal but has no change in meaning
It indicates that the action is habitual rather than a single event
It transforms the sentence into a question in formal registers
q_gram_c2_01_003.explanation: In Spanish, default word order SVO can be altered для information-structural purposes. Verb-Subject order (VS) places subject в rhematic (новый information) position: 'Llegó Juan' presents Juan's arrival as noteworthy или unexpected, whereas 'Juan llegó' treats Juan as already known (thematic). This VS order is common в literary и journalistic prose для dramatic effect.

q_gram_c2_01_004.question: Lo que ___ es una explicación clara, no excusas. (necesitar, present indicative, nosotros — emphatic pseudocleft)
q_gram_c2_01_004.explanation: In pseudocleft (oración pseudohendida) like 'Lo que necesitamos es...', verb в relative clause takes indicative потому что it refers к real, asserted need. The сослагательное наклонение would be used only if need were hypothetical или uncertain, который emphatic tone pseudocleft denies.
q_gram_c2_01_004.conjugation_info: necesitar (present indicative): necesito, necesitas, necesita, necesitamos, necesitáis, necesitan

q_gram_c2_01_005.question: Bonita respuesta ___ diste. (emphatic ironic construction with determiner)
q_gram_c2_01_005.explanation: The construction 'Bonita respuesta la que me diste' uses fronted predicative adjective + noun followed by relative clause introduced by 'la que', creating ironic или sarcastic emphasis. This stylistic pattern is characteristic colloquial yet rhetorically effective Spanish, implying response was anything но 'bonita'.
q_gram_c2_01_005.hint: The ironic construction uses определённый артикль + 'que' к introduce relative clause

q_gram_c2_01_006.question: Hubiera sido mejor que ___ la verdad desde el principio. (decir, pluperfect subjunctive, tú — formal literary register)
q_gram_c2_01_006.explanation: After 'hubiera sido mejor que', pluperfect сослагательное наклонение is needed к express counterfactual past situation с literary или formal tone. 'Hubieras dicho' uses hubiera + irregular past причастие 'dicho'. The alternative 'dijeras' (имперфект сослагательное наклонение) would shift meaning к unrealized present/general wish rather than regretted past action.
q_gram_c2_01_006.conjugation_info: decir (pluperfect сослагательное наклонение): hubiera dicho, hubieras dicho, hubiera dicho, hubiéramos dicho, hubierais dicho, hubieran dicho

q_gram_c2_01_007.question: De haber ___ la verdad, todo habría sido diferente. (saber, infinitive compound — literary concise style)
q_gram_c2_01_007.explanation: 'De + haber + past причастие' является compact literary alternative к 'si hubiera/hubiese + past причастие' для expressing counterfactual conditions. 'De haber sabido' = 'Si hubiera sabido' (If I had known). This construction is favored в elevated written registers для its conciseness и elegance.
q_gram_c2_01_007.hint: This construction replaces 'si + pluperfect сослагательное наклонение' с 'de + compound инфинитив'

q_gram_c2_01_008.question: It was precisely his arrogance that led to his downfall.
q_gram_c2_01_008.correct: Fue precisamente su arrogancia lo que provocó su caída.
wrong: Fue precisamente su arrogancia que provocó su caída.
Era precisamente su arrogancia la que provocaba su caída.
Precisamente su arrogancia fue que provocó su caída.
q_gram_c2_01_008.explanation: This является cleft sentence (oración hendida) focusing на 'su arrogancia'. Since focused element is abstract concept rather than specific gendered noun functioning as subject relative, neuter 'lo que' используется (не 'la que'). The претерит 'fue...provocó' указывает на completed past event. Omitting 'lo' before 'que' является common error.

q_gram_c2_01_009.question: Cuanto más se ___ en el tema, más complejo le parecía. (adentrar, imperfect subjunctive, él — literary concessive escalation)
q_gram_c2_01_009.explanation: 'Cuanto más...más...' с имперфект сослагательное наклонение в literary register creates correlative escalation structure. While 'adentraba' (indicative) would be acceptable в everyday Spanish, сослагательное наклонение 'adentrara' adds layer subjective perception consistent с 'le parecía'. Note: 'adentrase' (-se форма) is technically also correct но -ra форма is expected here.
q_gram_c2_01_009.conjugation_info: adentrarse (имперфект сослагательное наклонение): me adentrara, te adentraras, se adentrara, nos adentráramos, os adentrarais, se adentraran

q_gram_c2_01_010.question: No es que no quiera ayudarte; es que no puedo.
q_gram_c2_01_010.correct: It's not that I don't want to help you; it's that I can't.
wrong: It's not that I can't help you; it's that I don't want to.
I neither want to help you nor am I able to.
The reason is not that I want to help you; it's that I can.
q_gram_c2_01_010.explanation: 'No es que + сослагательное наклонение' (no quiera) negates one possible interpretation while 'es que + indicative' (no puedo) asserts real reason. This contrastive focus structure является hallmark nuanced Spanish argumentation, using сослагательное наклонение к deny и indicative к affirm. The stylistic effect is diplomatic self-justification.

q_gram_c2_02_001.question: Si así lo ___, que Dios se lo demande. (hacer, future subjunctive, él — archaic legal/religious formula)
q_gram_c2_02_001.explanation: The future сослагательное наклонение ('hiciere') survives в legal documents, religious oaths, и proverbs. From irregular претерит stem hic-, future сослагательное наклонение adds -iere. In modern everyday Spanish, это would be 'si lo hace' или 'si lo hiciera'.
q_gram_c2_02_001.conjugation_info: hacer (future сослагательное наклонение): hiciere, hicieres, hiciere, hiciéremos, hiciereis, hicieren

q_gram_c2_02_002.question: Apenas hubo ___ el rey, toda la corte enmudeció. (entrar, pretérito anterior — literary narrative)
q_gram_c2_02_002.explanation: The pretérito anterior ('hubo entrado') используется в literary prose after temporal conjunctions like 'apenas' (scarcely) к indicate action completed immediately before another past event. This tense is virtually extinct в spoken Spanish но appears в formal и literary writing. The past причастие 'entrar' is regular: 'entrado'.

q_gram_c2_02_003.question: Sea lo que ___, no me rendiré. (ser, future subjunctive — archaic concessive formula)
q_gram_c2_02_003.explanation: The expression 'sea lo que fuere' (come what may) preserves future сослагательное наклонение 'fuere' в fixed concessive formula. In modern Spanish, это is often regularized к 'sea lo que sea', но archaic форма persists в formal и literary registers. The future сослагательное наклонение 'ser' shares формах с 'ir': fuere, fueres, fuere, etc.

q_gram_c2_02_004.question: What is 'pretérito anterior' (hubo cantado) и why is it considered archaic?
q_gram_c2_02_004.correct: A compound past tense formed with the preterite of 'haber' + past participle, expressing immediate anteriority; it has been replaced by the simple preterite or pluperfect in all but literary usage
wrong: A simple past tense formed by adding special archaic endings to the verb stem, still common in legal texts
A conditional perfect tense that was used before the modern conditional emerged in the 16th century
A pluperfect indicative variant using 'ser' instead of 'haber' as the auxiliary, common until the 18th century
q_gram_c2_02_004.explanation: The pretérito anterior (hube cantado, hubiste cantado, hubo cantado, etc.) expresses action completed immediately before another past action. It appeared after temporal conjunctions like 'apenas', 'en cuanto', 'no bien'. It has been almost entirely replaced by simple претерит или pluperfect (había cantado) в modern Spanish, surviving only в very formal literary prose.

q_gram_c2_02_005.question: Donde ___ necesidad, acuda el ciudadano al servicio público. (haber, future subjunctive, archaic legal register)
q_gram_c2_02_005.explanation: In legal и administrative Spanish, future сослагательное наклонение 'hubiere' используется в условное наклонение или relative clauses referring к hypothetical future situations. 'Donde hubiere necesidad' означает 'wherever there may be need'. Modern non-legal Spanish would use 'donde haya necesidad'.
q_gram_c2_02_005.conjugation_info: haber (future сослагательное наклонение): hubiere, hubieres, hubiere, hubiéremos, hubiereis, hubieren

q_gram_c2_02_006.question: Pluguiera a Dios que ___ paz en el mundo. (haber — archaic optative construction)
q_gram_c2_02_006.explanation: 'Pluguiera Dios' (would который it pleased God) is archaic optative expression using имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'placer' (pluguiera). The following clause also takes сослагательное наклонение: 'hubiera paz'. In modern Spanish, это would be 'ojalá hubiera paz'. The verb 'placer' had irregular форма 'plugo' (претерит) от который 'pluguiera' derives.
q_gram_c2_02_006.hint: 'Pluguiera' is archaic имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'placer' (к please)

q_gram_c2_02_007.question: Whoever shall commit this offense will be punished according to the law.
q_gram_c2_02_007.correct: Quien cometiere esta falta será castigado conforme a la ley.
wrong: Quien cometa esta falta será castigado conforme a la ley.
Quien cometería esta falta sería castigado conforme a la ley.
Quien haya cometido esta falta ha sido castigado conforme a la ley.
q_gram_c2_02_007.explanation: In legal Spanish, 'quien + future сослагательное наклонение' (cometiere) используется для hypothetical future agents в statutory provisions. This parallels archaic English 'whoever shall commit'. While 'cometa' (present сослагательное наклонение) is acceptable в modern legal drafting, future сослагательное наклонение remains traditional форма в Spanish jurisprudence.

q_gram_c2_02_008.question: No bien hubo ___ la sentencia, el acusado se desplomó. (oír, pretérito anterior — literary narrative)
q_gram_c2_02_008.explanation: After 'no bien' (no sooner), pretérito anterior ('hubo oído') expresses action completed immediately before another past event. The past причастие 'oír' is 'oído' (с accent к break diphthong). This tense is reserved для highly formal literary narrative.
q_gram_c2_02_008.hint: The past причастие 'oír' has accent mark

q_gram_c2_02_009.question: Adonde fueres, haz lo que vieres.
q_gram_c2_02_009.correct: Wherever you may go, do as you may see (done). / When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
wrong: Wherever you went, do what you saw there.
Go where you want and do what you want.
Where you will go, see what you will do.
q_gram_c2_02_009.explanation: This famous proverb preserves future сослагательное наклонение ('fueres' от ir, 'vieres' от ver) в условное наклонение-concessive structure. It is Spanish equivalent 'When в Rome, do as Romans do'. The future сослагательное наклонение here expresses hypothetical, open-ended future situations в timeless proverbial way. This форма has been replaced by present сослагательное наклонение или indicative в все non-proverbial modern usage.

q_gram_c2_02_010.question: Si el demandado no ___ en el plazo de diez días, se procederá en rebeldía. (comparecer, future subjunctive, él — legal register)
q_gram_c2_02_010.explanation: In legal documents, future сослагательное наклонение используется в условное наклонение clauses about hypothetical future events. 'Si no compareciere' означает 'should defendant не appear'. The future сослагательное наклонение 'comparecer' is formed от претерит stem comparec- + -iere. Modern legal reform often replaces это с 'si no comparece'.
q_gram_c2_02_010.conjugation_info: comparecer (future сослагательное наклонение): compareciere, comparecieres, compareciere, compareciéremos, compareciereis, comparecieren

q_gram_c2_03_001.question: Vos ___ muy amable conmigo. (ser, Argentine voseo, present indicative)
q_gram_c2_03_001.explanation: In Argentine и Rioplatense voseo, present indicative 'ser' с 'vos' is 'sos' (не Peninsular 'eres' для tú или 'sois' для vosotros). The voseo conjugation обычно stresses last syllable и simplifies diphthongs.
q_gram_c2_03_001.hint: Argentine voseo uses unique настоящее время формах

q_gram_c2_03_002.question: En algunas regiones, se usa 'le' en lugar de 'lo' como pronombre de objeto directo masculino: 'Le vi ayer.' Esto se llama ___.
q_gram_c2_03_002.explanation: Leísmo is use indirect object pronoun 'le' в place direct object pronoun 'lo' (или 'la'). 'Le vi ayer' instead 'Lo vi ayer' is characteristic central Spain (Castile). The RAE accepts leísmo для мужского рода единственного числа animate referents но considers it incorrect для женского рода или inanimate referents.

q_gram_c2_03_003.question: What is key grammatical difference between 'ustedes' usage в Peninsular Spanish и Latin American Spanish?
q_gram_c2_03_003.correct: In Peninsular Spanish, 'ustedes' is exclusively formal plural (vs. informal 'vosotros'); in Latin American Spanish, 'ustedes' serves as both formal and informal plural, replacing 'vosotros' entirely
wrong: In Peninsular Spanish, 'ustedes' takes second-person plural verbs; in Latin American Spanish it takes third-person plural verbs
In Peninsular Spanish, 'ustedes' is only used for women; in Latin American Spanish it is gender-neutral
There is no grammatical difference; the distinction is purely one of pronunciation
q_gram_c2_03_003.explanation: This is one most significant dialectal grammar differences в Spanish. Peninsular Spanish maintains two-way informal/formal distinction в множественного числа: vosotros/as (informal) vs. ustedes (formal). Latin American Spanish has eliminated 'vosotros' entirely, using 'ustedes' с third-person множественного числа verbs для все множественного числа addresses regardless formality.

q_gram_c2_03_004.question: Vos ___ a la fiesta anoche, ¿verdad? (ir, Argentine voseo, preterite)
q_gram_c2_03_004.explanation: In Argentine voseo, претерит формах являются identical к standard 'tú' формах. 'Vos fuiste' is correct, не 'fuistes' (common hypercorrection) или 'fuisteis' (vosotros форма). The voseo diverges от tuteo mainly в present indicative, present сослагательное наклонение, и повелительное наклонение, не в претерит.
q_gram_c2_03_004.conjugation_info: ir (претерит с voseo): vos fuiste (same as tú fuiste)

q_gram_c2_03_005.question: La di un libro a María. (identify the dialectal phenomenon and the standard correction: ___)
q_gram_c2_03_005.correct: laísmo — the standard form is 'Le di un libro a María'
wrong: leísmo — the standard form is 'Lo di un libro a María'
loísmo — the standard form is 'Le di un libro a María'
dequeísmo — the standard form is 'La di de un libro a María'
q_gram_c2_03_005.explanation: Laísmo is use 'la' as indirect object pronoun для женского рода referents instead standard 'le'. 'La di un libro' should be 'Le di un libro' потому что 'dar algo alguien' requires indirect object pronoun ('le'). Laísmo is common в parts central Spain (Madrid, Castile) но is considered incorrect by RAE.

q_gram_c2_03_006.question: ¡Sentate acá! (rewrite using voseo imperative of 'sentarse' — identify the correct form)
q_gram_c2_03_006.explanation: In Argentine voseo повелительное наклонение, -ar verbs drop final -r инфинитив и stress last syllable: sentar → sentá. With reflexive pronoun 'te', it becomes 'sentate' (no written accent потому что stress falls naturally на penultimate syllable combined форма). Peninsular 'siéntate' uses tú повелительное наклонение с stem change.
q_gram_c2_03_006.conjugation_info: sentarse (voseo повелительное наклонение): sentate | Standard tú повелительное наклонение: siéntate

q_gram_c2_03_007.question: En el Caribe, es común escuchar la aspiración o elisión de la /s/ final. ¿Cómo se pronunciaría 'estos libros' en esta variedad?
q_gram_c2_03_007.explanation: In Caribbean Spanish (Cuba, Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, coastal Venezuela и Colombia), word-final и syllable-final /s/ is frequently aspirated к [h] или deleted entirely. 'Estos libros' becomes approximately [ehtoh libroh]. This phonological feature is one most recognizable markers Caribbean и lowland Latin American dialects.
q_gram_c2_03_007.hint: The /s/ is aspirated (weakened к 'h' sound), не changed к 'z'

q_gram_c2_03_008.question: I saw him yesterday at the market. (Translate using the leísmo form accepted by the RAE for masculine singular animate referents)
q_gram_c2_03_008.correct: Le vi ayer en el mercado.
wrong: Lo vi ayer en el mercado.
La vi ayer en el mercado.
Les vi ayer en el mercado.
q_gram_c2_03_008.explanation: The RAE accepts leísmo для мужского рода единственного числа animate referents: 'Le vi' (instead etymologically correct 'Lo vi') when referring к male person. This is only type leísmo considered acceptable. Leísmo с женского рода, множественного числа, или inanimate referents is не accepted.

q_gram_c2_03_009.question: Vos ___ que estudiar más si querés aprobar. (tener, Argentine voseo, present indicative)
q_gram_c2_03_009.explanation: In Argentine voseo, -er verbs в present indicative stress final syllable и eliminate diphthong: tener → tenés (не tienes). Chilean voseo sometimes uses 'tenís' (с aspiration), но Rioplatense форма is 'tenés'. The vosotros форма 'tenéis' is не used в Latin America.
q_gram_c2_03_009.conjugation_info: tener (present indicative, voseo): vos tenés | Chilean: vos tenís | Standard tú: tienes

q_gram_c2_03_010.question: ¿Vos querés que yo te lo diga o preferís que me calle?
q_gram_c2_03_010.correct: Do you want me to tell you, or do you prefer that I keep quiet?
wrong: Do you all want me to tell you, or do you prefer that I remain silent?
Would you like me to tell you, or would you prefer that I shut up?
Did you want me to tell you, or did you prefer that I stayed quiet?
q_gram_c2_03_010.explanation: This sentence uses Argentine voseo формах: 'querés' (present indicative querer с vos) и 'preferís' (present indicative preferir с vos). The 'vos' pronoun addresses single person informally, equivalent к 'tú', не множественного числа 'vosotros'. The сослагательное наклонение формах 'diga' и 'calle' remain standard regardless voseo.

q_gram_c2_04_001.question: ¿No le ___ abrir la ventana? (importar, conditional, usted — polite indirect request)
q_gram_c2_04_001.explanation: The условное наклонение 'importaría' softens request, making it more polite than present 'importa'. '¿No le importaría abrir la ventana?' (Would you mind opening window?) является conventional indirect speech act: literal question about hearer's feelings functions pragmatically as polite request.
q_gram_c2_04_001.conjugation_info: importar (условное наклонение): importaría, importarías, importaría, importaríamos, importaríais, importarían

q_gram_c2_04_002.question: Yo que tú, no ___ eso. (decir, conditional, yo — pragmatic advice softener)
q_gram_c2_04_002.explanation: 'Yo que tú' (if I were you) is idiomatic pragmatic softener used к give advice indirectly. The main clause takes условное наклонение ('diría') к express hypothetical nature advice. This structure is more tactful than direct повелительное наклонение like 'no digas eso'.
q_gram_c2_04_002.hint: 'Yo que tú' functions like 'si yo fuera tú' но is more colloquial

q_gram_c2_04_003.question: Disculpe, ¿me ___ indicar dónde está la estación? (poder, conditional — formal politeness strategy)
q_gram_c2_04_003.explanation: Using условное наклонение 'podría' instead present 'puede' является negative politeness strategy который respects hearer's autonomy by framing request as hypothetical rather than presumptive. 'Podría' implies 'if it wouldn't be too much trouble', creating social distance appropriate для speaking с strangers.
q_gram_c2_04_003.hint: The условное наклонение creates social distance и reduces imposition

q_gram_c2_04_004.question: What pragmatic function does diminutive serve в Mexican Spanish expression 'ahorita vengo'?
q_gram_c2_04_004.correct: It functions as a pragmatic softener indicating immediacy and reassurance, not literal smallness — it means 'I'll be right back'
wrong: It indicates that the speaker will come back for only a short visit
It is a grammatical error common in uneducated speech, as 'ahora' cannot take diminutives
It means the speaker is going to a small or nearby place
q_gram_c2_04_004.explanation: 'Ahorita' в Mexican и Central American Spanish является pragmatic diminutive который modifies temporal adverb 'ahora'. Rather than indicating smallness, diminutive suffix -ita serves as softening и immediatizing device: 'ahorita' feels warmer и more immediate than 'ahora'. This pragmatic use diminutives extends к many expressions: 'cerquita' (nice и close), 'lueguito' (right away).

q_gram_c2_04_005.question: Quisiera ___ una mesa para dos, por favor. (reservar — ultra-polite request using imperfect subjunctive of querer)
q_gram_c2_04_005.explanation: 'Quisiera + инфинитив' is most polite request форма в Spanish, using имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'querer' (-ra форма). It is more polite than 'querría' (условное наклонение) и far more polite than 'quiero' (present). The инфинитив 'reservar' follows directly потому что subject both verbs is same person.
q_gram_c2_04_005.conjugation_info: querer (имперфект сослагательное наклонение): quisiera, quisieras, quisiera, quisiéramos, quisierais, quisieran

q_gram_c2_04_006.question: Es que no ___ la hora de la reunión. (saber, imperfect indicative, yo — excuse-giving pragmatic marker)
q_gram_c2_04_006.explanation: 'Es que' является pragmatic discourse marker used к introduce excuses, explanations, или justifications. It prefaces speaker's reason в way который solicits hearer's understanding. Here, 'es que no sabía' (thing is, I didn't know) uses имперфект 'sabía' к describe ongoing state ignorance as mitigating excuse.
q_gram_c2_04_006.hint: 'Es que' introduces explanation, и имперфект describes ongoing past state

q_gram_c2_04_007.question: I was wondering if you could help me with this report. (Translate using maximum politeness)
q_gram_c2_04_007.correct: Me preguntaba si podría ayudarme con este informe.
wrong: Me pregunto si puede ayudarme con este informe.
Me pregunté si pudieras ayudarme con este informe.
Preguntaría si me ayuda con este informe.
q_gram_c2_04_007.explanation: Maximum politeness в Spanish stacks multiple distancing strategies: имперфект 'preguntaba' (past tense для psychological distance) + условное наклонение 'podría' (hypothetical framing). This double softening mirrors English 'I was wondering if you could...'. Using настоящее время 'pregunto' и 'puede' would be significantly more direct.

q_gram_c2_04_008.question: Hombre, ___ que no es tan difícil como parece. (pragmatic filler particle + verb, present indicative, yo)
q_gram_c2_04_008.explanation: The vocative 'hombre' (literally 'man') functions as pragmatic marker familiarity и mild disagreement, не as gendered address. 'Yo creo que' с indicative asserts speaker's belief while explicit 'yo' adds mild emphasis. This combination 'hombre' + 'yo creo que' является common conversational strategy для softening contrary opinion.
q_gram_c2_04_008.hint: 'Hombre' here является discourse marker, и verb expresses personal opinion

q_gram_c2_04_009.question: No sé cómo decirle esto, pero me temo que su solicitud no ha sido aceptada.
q_gram_c2_04_009.correct: I don't know how to tell you this, but I'm afraid your application has not been accepted.
wrong: I don't know what to say, but I think your request was not accepted.
I cannot tell you this, but I fear that your application was rejected.
I'm not sure how to say this, but your application might not have been accepted.
q_gram_c2_04_009.explanation: This sentence demonstrates multiple pragmatic softening strategies для delivering плохой news: 'no sé cómo decirle' (prefatory hedging), 'me temo que' (epistemic distancing — literally 'I fear который'), и formal 'le' (usted register). The present perfect 'ha sido aceptada' is appropriate tense для announcing result, и passive voice depersonalizes rejection.

q_gram_c2_04_010.question: ¿No ___ usted tan amable de pasarme la sal? (ser, future indicative — rhetorical politeness with future tense)
q_gram_c2_04_010.explanation: The будущее время can be used pragmatically для polite requests в Spanish: '¿No será usted tan amable de...?' (Won't you be поэтому kind as к...?). This is 'future politeness', where будущее время creates psychological distance similar к условное наклонение. While 'sería' is also very polite, будущее время version has slightly more formal, старый-fashioned elegance.
q_gram_c2_04_010.conjugation_info: ser (future indicative): seré, serás, será, seremos, seréis, serán

q_gram_c2_05_001.question: El presunto autor del robo ___ detenido ayer por la policía. (ser, preterite — journalistic passive voice)
q_gram_c2_05_001.explanation: In journalistic Spanish, passive voice с 'ser' в претерит ('fue detenido') is standard для reporting completed events. This contrasts с everyday spoken Spanish, который strongly prefers active constructions или 'se' passives. The journalistic passive creates objectivity и formality. 'Ha sido' (present perfect) would suggest closer temporal relevance.
q_gram_c2_05_001.hint: Journalistic reporting completed past event uses претерит passive

q_gram_c2_05_002.question: Según fuentes consultadas, el acuerdo ___ firmado en los próximos días. (ser, future — journalistic hedged prediction)
q_gram_c2_05_002.explanation: In journalistic Spanish, 'será firmado' (future passive) reports predicted event as fact. The attribution 'según fuentes consultadas' provides hedge. The условное наклонение 'sería' would indicate more uncertainty. Journalistic register frequently uses future passive constructions который would sound unnatural в everyday conversation.
q_gram_c2_05_002.hint: Journalistic predictions about scheduled future events use будущее время

q_gram_c2_05_003.question: What is primary grammatical characteristic legal Spanish который distinguishes it от everyday language?
q_gram_c2_05_003.correct: Heavy use of future subjunctive, long nominal phrases, archaic formulas, and passive constructions with 'ser', resulting in highly complex sentence structures
wrong: Exclusive use of the informal 'tú' register to make legal texts accessible to all citizens
Predominance of simple present tense and short sentences for clarity and precision
Use of the imperative mood throughout, since laws are commands to citizens
q_gram_c2_05_003.explanation: Legal Spanish (español jurídico) is characterized by future сослагательное наклонение ('si el acusado negare...'), lengthy subordinate clauses, nominal phrases (nominalization verbs), archaic formulas ('por la presente', 'en virtud de'), и passive voice с 'ser'. These features create density и formality который can make legal texts nearly impenetrable к non-specialists.

q_gram_c2_05_004.question: Se ___ que los resultados confirman la hipótesis inicial. (observar, preterite, impersonal 'se' — scientific register)
q_gram_c2_05_004.explanation: In scientific Spanish, impersonal 'se' + претерит ('se observó') is standard way к report findings objectively, avoiding personal subjects like 'yo observé' или 'nosotros observamos'. The претерит указывает на completed observation within study. This impersonal construction является defining feature academic и scientific writing в Spanish.
q_gram_c2_05_004.conjugation_info: observar (претерит): observé, observaste, observó, observamos, observasteis, observaron

q_gram_c2_05_005.question: Los datos ___ analizados mediante un método estadístico de regresión lineal. (ser, preterite, passive — scientific paper methodology section)
q_gram_c2_05_005.explanation: In methodology section scientific papers, passive претерит ('fueron analizados') reports completed procedures. This passive construction maintains impersonal tone expected в academic writing. 'Han sido' (present perfect) would be used для results с ongoing relevance, while претерит указывает на discrete completed action within study.
q_gram_c2_05_005.hint: The methodology section describes completed procedures

q_gram_c2_05_006.question: Descubre ___ tu nueva piel con nuestra crema revolucionaria. (a verb form typical of advertising — tú imperative of 'ser')
q_gram_c2_05_006.explanation: Advertising Spanish heavily favors informal повелительное наклонение к create urgency и personal connection: 'Descubre' (discover), 'sé' (be). The tú повелительное наклонение 'ser' is irregular форма 'sé' (identical к yo форма 'saber'). Advertising discourse strings imperatives together к build excitement. Using 'usted' формах would create unwanted distance в most modern ad copy.
q_gram_c2_05_006.conjugation_info: ser (повелительное наклонение): sé (tú), sea (usted), sed (vosotros), sean (ustedes)

q_gram_c2_05_007.question: La tasa de desempleo ___ incrementado en un 2% durante el último trimestre, según el INE. (haberse, present perfect, impersonal reflexive — economic journalism)
q_gram_c2_05_007.explanation: Economic journalism в Spanish uses reflexive impersonal construction 'se ha incrementado' к present data objectively. The present perfect ('se ha incrementado') используется потому что time frame ('durante el último trimestre') connects к present. This reflexive-passive is preferred over agentive passive ('ha sido incrementada') потому что no specific agent caused increase.
q_gram_c2_05_007.hint: The increase happened within recent time frame connected к present

q_gram_c2_05_008.question: It was concluded that the treatment significantly reduces symptoms in 78% of patients. (Translate using scientific register)
q_gram_c2_05_008.correct: Se concluyó que el tratamiento reduce significativamente los síntomas en el 78% de los pacientes.
wrong: Concluimos que el tratamiento reduce significativamente los síntomas en el 78% de los pacientes.
Fue concluido que el tratamiento reduce los síntomas significativamente en 78% de los pacientes.
Se ha concluido que el tratamiento redujo los síntomas en el 78% de los pacientes.
q_gram_c2_05_008.explanation: Scientific Spanish uses impersonal 'se concluyó' rather than personal 'concluimos' или passive 'fue concluido' (который is grammatically awkward с 'concluir' в это context). The article 'el' before '78%' is standard в Spanish scientific writing. 'Significativamente' is placed before verb it modifies для formal precision.

q_gram_c2_05_009.question: Por la presente, se ___ a las partes que el plazo vence el día 15 del corriente mes. (notificar, present indicative, impersonal 'se' — legal/administrative register)
q_gram_c2_05_009.explanation: In legal и administrative documents, 'por la presente' (hereby) introduces formal notification using impersonal 'se' + present indicative. 'Se notifica' (hereby it is notified) performs legal speech act at moment writing. The performative настоящее время makes notification effective upon issuance. The formula 'del corriente mes' ( current month) является fixed legal expression.
q_gram_c2_05_009.conjugation_info: notificar (present indicative): notifico, notificas, notifica, notificamos, notificáis, notifican

q_gram_c2_05_010.question: Habida cuenta de las circunstancias expuestas, este tribunal resuelve desestimar la demanda interpuesta.
q_gram_c2_05_010.correct: In consideration of the circumstances set forth, this court resolves to dismiss the complaint filed.
wrong: Having considered the exposed circumstances, this tribunal resolves to disregard the demand.
Given that the circumstances have been expressed, this court decides to reject the interpellated demand.
On account of the stated circumstances, this court orders the removal of the intermediary claim.
q_gram_c2_05_010.explanation: 'Habida cuenta de' (в consideration ) является fixed legal formula. 'Circunstancias expuestas' означает 'circumstances set forth' (не 'exposed'). 'Resuelve desestimar' is legal performative для 'resolves к dismiss'. 'Demanda interpuesta' означает 'complaint filed' (не 'intermediary' или 'interpellated'). Legal Spanish relies heavily на such fixed collocations который have specific technical meanings distinct от everyday usage.

q_gram_c2_06_001.question: El informe concluye lo siguiente___ los resultados son definitivos. (Выберите правильный punctuation + conjunction pattern)
q_gram_c2_06_001.explanation: After 'lo siguiente' (following), colon (:) is required в Spanish к introduce what follows. A semicolon would separate independent clauses without introductory relationship, и dash используется для parenthetical insertions, не introductions.
q_gram_c2_06_001.conjugation_info: Colon usage: after 'lo siguiente', 'saber', 'es decir' when introducing explanatory content

q_gram_c2_06_002.question: La propuesta fue rechazada___ sin embargo, el comité acordó reconsiderarla.
q_gram_c2_06_002.explanation: A semicolon is required before adversative conjuncts like 'sin embargo', 'no obstante', и 'ahora bien' when they connect two independent clauses. A comma alone creates comma splice (coma criminal) в formal Spanish prose.
q_gram_c2_06_002.hint: Adversative connectors between independent clauses require stronger punctuation than comma

q_gram_c2_06_003.question: Tres ciudades participaron en el proyecto___ Madrid, Barcelona y Sevilla.
q_gram_c2_06_003.explanation: A colon используется before enumeration который has been announced by cataphoric element (в это case, 'tres ciudades'). The colon signals который what follows specifies или lists what was previously announced. A dash would only be appropriate для parenthetical aside.
q_gram_c2_06_003.hint: The sentence announces list с 'tres ciudades' — what punctuation introduces enumeration?

q_gram_c2_06_004.question: What is grammatical difference between 'Mi hermano, que vive en Madrid, es médico' и 'Mi hermano que vive en Madrid es médico'?
q_gram_c2_06_004.correct: The first (with commas) is a non-restrictive clause implying one brother; the second (without commas) is restrictive, implying there are multiple brothers and identifying which one
wrong: There is no grammatical difference; the commas are optional stylistic choices
The first is informal and the second is formal register
The first uses the indicative mood and the second implies subjunctive
q_gram_c2_06_004.explanation: In Spanish, commas around relative clause determine whether it is explicativa (non-restrictive, providing extra information) или especificativa (restrictive, narrowing down который referent). This punctuation distinction changes meaning: с commas, speaker has one brother; without, speaker has multiple brothers и is specifying который one.

q_gram_c2_06_005.question: El director declaró___ «No habrá más despidos este trimestre». (The director stated___)
q_gram_c2_06_005.explanation: In Spanish, colon precedes direct quotation introduced by verb communication (declarar, decir, afirmar). Unlike English, который may use comma, Spanish formal style requires colon before quoted speech when introduced by declarative verb.
q_gram_c2_06_005.conjugation_info: Verbs communication (declarar, afirmar, señalar) + colon + quoted speech is standard в formal/journalistic Spanish

q_gram_c2_06_006.question: Todo estaba en calma___ de repente, un ruido ensordecedor sacudió el edificio.
q_gram_c2_06_006.explanation: A semicolon separates two closely related independent clauses where second introduces contrasting или unexpected turn. 'De repente' (suddenly) introduces shift; semicolon is stronger than comma (который would create comma splice) но maintains close narrative relationship который full stop would sever.
q_gram_c2_06_006.hint: Two independent clauses с close temporal relationship и dramatic contrast

q_gram_c2_06_007.question: The results were as follows: three in favor, two against, and one abstention.
q_gram_c2_06_007.correct: Los resultados fueron los siguientes: tres a favor, dos en contra y una abstención.
wrong: Los resultados fueron los siguientes; tres a favor, dos en contra y una abstención.
Los resultados fueron los siguientes — tres a favor, dos en contra y una abstención.
Los resultados fueron los siguientes, tres a favor, dos en contra y una abstención.
q_gram_c2_06_007.explanation: After 'los siguientes' (following), Spanish requires colon к introduce enumeration. Note который в Spanish, serial comma (Oxford comma) before 'y' is не used — unlike English, Spanish omits comma before final conjunction в simple list.

q_gram_c2_06_008.question: Solo quería una cosa___ que lo dejaran en paz.
q_gram_c2_06_008.explanation: A colon follows cataphoric expression ('una cosa') который announces what will be specified. The colon introduces specification 'una cosa'. This is distinct от dash (raya), который would be used для parenthetical aside или interruption, не direct specification.
q_gram_c2_06_008.hint: 'Una cosa' announces specification — what punctuation mark introduces it?

q_gram_c2_06_009.question: La cuestión es sencilla: o aceptamos las condiciones —por injustas que sean— o nos retiramos del acuerdo.
q_gram_c2_06_009.correct: The issue is simple: either we accept the conditions — however unjust they may be — or we withdraw from the agreement.
wrong: The simple question is: we accept the conditions, however unjust they are, or we withdraw from the agreement.
The issue is simple; either we accept the conditions (however unjust they are) or we withdraw from the agreement.
The question is easy: or we accept the conditions — for unjust as they are — or we retire from the agreement.
q_gram_c2_06_009.explanation: The colon after 'sencilla' introduces explanation. The em dashes (rayas) enclose concessive parenthetical clause ('por injustas que sean' = however unjust they may be). 'Retirarse del acuerdo' означает 'к withdraw от agreement', не 'к retire'. The correlative 'o...o' translates к 'either...или'.

q_gram_c2_06_010.question: Había dos opciones —según nos explicaron—___ aceptar o renunciar. (haber, imperfect indicative — already conjugated; choose the correct punctuation after the parenthetical)
q_gram_c2_06_010.explanation: The em dashes (rayas) enclose parenthetical 'según nos explicaron' (as they explained к us). After closing dash, colon introduces specification 'dos opciones'. The colon functions as cataphoric marker, и parenthetical insertion between dashes does не change punctuation logic main sentence.
q_gram_c2_06_010.conjugation_info: Parenthetical insertions between rayas do не alter punctuation requirements main clause structure

q_gram_c2_07_001.question: Sírvase ___ a la recepción a las nueve en punto. (acudir, ultra-formal imperative usted)
q_gram_c2_07_001.explanation: 'Sírvase' + инфинитив is ultra-formal повелительное наклонение construction used в official correspondence, legal documents, и bureaucratic language. 'Sírvase acudir' is more formal than 'acuda' (standard formal повелительное наклонение). This register is characteristic administrative Spanish.
q_gram_c2_07_001.hint: 'Sírvase' стоит перед инфинитив в ultra-formal register

q_gram_c2_07_002.question: Tío, es que ___ flipando con lo que me ha dicho el profe. (estar, colloquial present progressive, yo form)
q_gram_c2_07_002.explanation: In colloquial Spanish (registro coloquial), 'tío' (dude), 'es que' (it's just который), 'flipar' (к freak out), и 'profe' (teacher, truncated) являются markers informal youth register. The present progressive 'estoy flipando' conveys immediate emotional reaction typical spoken informal Spanish.

q_gram_c2_07_003.question: What register shift occurs when speaker says 'Ruego usted tenga bien considerar mi solicitud' versus 'Por favor, considere mi solicitud'?
q_gram_c2_07_003.correct: Both are formal, but the first uses ultra-formal bureaucratic register with archaic constructions ('tenga a bien'), while the second is standard polite formal register
wrong: The first is informal because it uses 'ruego' which is a casual word
Both sentences are in exactly the same register with no meaningful difference
The first is written register and the second can only be used in spoken language
q_gram_c2_07_003.explanation: 'Tener bien' (к see fit к) is ultra-formal/archaic construction found в legal и administrative documents. 'Ruego usted tenga bien' belongs к highest formality tier (registro solemne/protocolario), while 'por favor, considere' is standard formal (registro formal estándar). Mastering register означает recognizing these gradations.

q_gram_c2_07_004.question: Se ___ a los señores pasajeros que abrochen sus cinturones. (rogar, formal announcement, third person singular passive)
q_gram_c2_07_004.explanation: 'Se ruega los señores pasajeros' (passengers являются kindly requested) является formulaic expression в formal public announcements. The impersonal 'se' + third person единственного числа 'rogar' creates depersonalized, institutional voice. 'Se pide' would be less formal; 'se solicita' используется для applications; 'se implora' is too emotionally charged.
q_gram_c2_07_004.conjugation_info: rogar (present indicative): ruego, ruegas, ruega, rogamos, rogáis, ruegan — note o→ue stem change

q_gram_c2_07_005.question: Habida cuenta de las circunstancias, ___ oportuno aplazar la sesión. (resultar, ultra-formal written register)
q_gram_c2_07_005.explanation: 'Habida cuenta de' (в view / given) is ultra-formal connector used в legal, academic, и parliamentary discourse. 'Resulta oportuno' (it proves/turns out к be appropriate) is register-appropriate verb choice. 'Es oportuno' would be standard formal; 'resultar' adds nuance objective conclusion characteristic это register.
q_gram_c2_07_005.hint: 'Habida cuenta de' signals ultra-formal register — который verb matches это tone?

q_gram_c2_07_006.question: Quienquiera que ___ responsable deberá rendir cuentas ante el tribunal. (ser, present subjunctive, formal legal register)
q_gram_c2_07_006.explanation: 'Quienquiera que' (whoever) является formal/literary pronoun который always triggers сослагательное наклонение. In legal register referring к present/future unknown person, present сослагательное наклонение 'sea' is required. The имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'fuera/fuese' would be used для past или hypothetical contexts.
q_gram_c2_07_006.conjugation_info: ser (present сослагательное наклонение): sea, seas, sea, seamos, seáis, sean

q_gram_c2_07_007.question: Venga, ¡___ aquí! ¡Que no pasa nada, hombre! (venir, informal tú imperative, colloquial register)
q_gram_c2_07_007.explanation: In colloquial register, discourse markers like 'venga' (come на), 'hombre' (man/dude, regardless gender), и 'que no pasa nada' (it's no большой deal) signal intimacy и informality. The tú повелительное наклонение 'ven' matches это register. 'Venga' (usted повелительное наклонение) would clash с colloquial tone.
q_gram_c2_07_007.hint: The colloquial markers (venga, hombre) signal tú register

q_gram_c2_07_008.question: I hereby request that my application be reconsidered. (ultra-formal register)
q_gram_c2_07_008.correct: Por la presente, solicito que mi solicitud sea reconsiderada.
wrong: Quiero que se reconsidere mi solicitud, por favor.
Le ruego me reconsidere la solicitud.
q_gram_c2_07_008.explanation: 'Por la presente' (hereby) является formulaic expression exclusive к ultra-formal written register (legal, administrative). 'Solicito que... sea reconsiderada' uses formal verb 'solicitar' с passive сослагательное наклонение, matching institutional tone. The alternatives являются progressively less formal и would не appear в official documents.

q_gram_c2_07_009.question: Dígnese Su Señoría ___ las pruebas que a continuación se exponen. (examinar, ultra-formal judicial imperative)
q_gram_c2_07_009.explanation: 'Dígnese' (may [Your Honor] deign к) + инфинитив is most formal повелительное наклонение construction в Spanish, reserved для addressing judges (Su Señoría), royalty, или high dignitaries. This archaic construction follows pattern: reflexive courtesy verb + инфинитив. It represents highest register tier в Spanish.
q_gram_c2_07_009.conjugation_info: dignarse (formal повелительное наклонение): dígnese + инфинитив — ultra-formal/judicial register only

q_gram_c2_07_010.question: Mola mogollón, ¿eh? Es que el tío ese es un crack total, ¿sabes?
q_gram_c2_07_010.correct: It's really cool, right? The thing is, that guy is an absolute legend, you know?
wrong: It bothers a lot, right? That uncle is a total crack, do you know?
It's a little cool, isn't it? That man is a complete failure, you know?
It is moderately annoying, correct? The gentleman is a total expert, do you understand?
q_gram_c2_07_010.explanation: 'Molar' (к be cool, colloquial), 'mogollón' (ton/really, colloquial intensifier), 'tío' (guy/dude, не 'uncle' here), 'un crack' (legend/genius, от English), и '¿sabes?' (you know?, phatic) являются все markers highly colloquial youth register. Translating register accurately означает choosing equivalent colloquial expressions в target language.

q_gram_c2_08_001.question: Caminaba por la calle cuando, de pronto, ___ ante él una figura sombría. (aparecer, literary pretérito indefinido for narrative rupture)
q_gram_c2_08_001.explanation: In literary narrative, имперфект ('caminaba') sets background scene, и pretérito indefinido ('apareció') interrupts с foreground event. This alternation between имперфект (description/background) и indefinido (action/foreground) is fundamental к Spanish narrative technique. 'De pronto' (suddenly) signals narrative rupture.
q_gram_c2_08_001.conjugation_info: aparecer (pretérito indefinido): aparecí, apareciste, apareció, aparecimos, aparecisteis, aparecieron

q_gram_c2_08_002.question: No podía creerlo. ___ irse de allí cuanto antes. Nadie debía enterarse. (tener que, free indirect style, imperfect)
q_gram_c2_08_002.explanation: Free indirect style (estilo indirecto libre) blends narrator's voice с character's thoughts without quotation marks или reporting verbs. The имперфект 'tenía que' reflects character's internal urgency as filtered through narrator. The short, decisive sentences ('No podía creerlo. Tenía que irse.') являются characteristic это literary technique.
q_gram_c2_08_002.hint: Free indirect style uses character's tense perspective — here, имперфект mirrors internal thought

q_gram_c2_08_003.question: Y el soldado, que nunca ___ miedo a nada, tembló por primera vez. (haber tenido, pluperfect indicative for literary characterization)
q_gram_c2_08_003.explanation: The pluperfect 'había tenido' establishes character trait который held true up until narrative moment rupture ('tembló por primera vez'). In literary analysis, pluperfect creates temporal depth который имперфект или indefinido alone cannot achieve — it frames character's entire past as context для present dramatic event.
q_gram_c2_08_003.hint: The pluperfect establishes completed state prior к narrative turning point

q_gram_c2_08_004.question: In literary analysis, what is the grammatical function of the 'presente histórico' (historical present) in narrative prose?
q_gram_c2_08_004.correct: It uses present tense to narrate past events, creating immediacy and dramatic vividness by collapsing the temporal distance between narrator and events
wrong: It is used only in dialogue to indicate characters speaking in real time
It is a subjunctive form used to express the author's doubts about historical accuracy
It is a future tense form used to foreshadow upcoming events in the plot
q_gram_c2_08_004.explanation: The presente histórico является powerful literary device where past events являются narrated в настоящее время ('Colón llega América en 1492'). Grammatically, it transposes temporal frame, creating effect immediacy и reader immersion. In literary analysis, recognizing это device is essential для understanding narrative perspective и author's stylistic choices.

q_gram_c2_08_005.question: Mañana ___ el día decisivo. Lo sabía. Lo sentía en los huesos. (ser, literary present for narrative anticipation mixed with imperfect for interiority)
q_gram_c2_08_005.explanation: The условное наклонение 'sería' в literary narrative functions as 'future past' — it expresses character's anticipation future event от past narrative standpoint. Combined с имперфект ('sabía', 'sentía'), it creates layered temporal perspective characteristic sophisticated literary prose. This is distinct от simple имперфект 'era', который would merely describe.
q_gram_c2_08_005.conjugation_info: ser (условное наклонение): sería, serías, sería, seríamos, seríais, serían

q_gram_c2_08_006.question: Le miraron con desprecio. ___ un intruso, un don nadie. ¿Qué hacía allí? (ser, free indirect style, imperfect)
q_gram_c2_08_006.explanation: In free indirect style, имперфект 'era' expresses collective judgment characters ('le miraron') as internalized thought. The rhetorical question '¿Qué hacía allí?' further signals free indirect style — it is neither narrator's nor character's direct speech, но fusion both perspectives. The имперфект maintains narrative past frame.
q_gram_c2_08_006.hint: Free indirect style merges narrator и character perspective using past tenses

q_gram_c2_08_007.question: She had never imagined that love could hurt so much. (literary translation, pluperfect + free indirect style)
q_gram_c2_08_007.correct: Nunca había imaginado que el amor pudiera doler tanto.
wrong: Nunca imaginó que el amor podía doler tanto.
Ella no ha imaginado que el amor pueda doler tanto.
Nunca se imaginaba que el amor dolería tanto.
q_gram_c2_08_007.explanation: The pluperfect 'había imaginado' + имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'pudiera' creates literary depth: pluperfect establishes character's prior state ignorance, и сослагательное наклонение 'pudiera' (rather than indicative 'podía') adds layer unreality к subordinate clause, characteristic literary prose который conveys subjective experience.

q_gram_c2_08_008.question: Llovía. Las calles ___ desiertas. Un perro aullaba a lo lejos. (estar, imperfect for literary scene-setting)
q_gram_c2_08_008.explanation: The accumulation имперфект verbs ('llovía', 'estaban', 'aullaba') creates literary backdrop — static, atmospheric scene before narrative action begins. This technique, called 'descriptive имперфект' или 'imperfecto descriptivo', is fundamental в literary analysis. Each имперфект verb adds layer к setting without advancing plot.
q_gram_c2_08_008.hint: Scene-setting в literary narrative uses accumulated имперфект verbs

q_gram_c2_08_009.question: Hubiera querido gritar, pero las palabras se le atragantaron en la garganta.
q_gram_c2_08_009.correct: She would have wanted to scream, but the words got stuck in her throat.
wrong: She wanted to scream, but the words were stuck in her throat.
She had wanted to scream, but the words would get stuck in her throat.
If she had wanted to scream, the words stuck in her throat.
q_gram_c2_08_009.explanation: In literary Spanish, 'hubiera querido' (pluperfect сослагательное наклонение) can replace 'habría querido' (условное наклонение perfect) к express unrealized desire. This является literary register choice — сослагательное наклонение форма adds emotional weight и sense impossibility. 'Se le atragantaron' (indefinido) conveys sudden, completed physical sensation.

q_gram_c2_08_010.question: Y entonces lo ___: aquella no era su vida, sino la de otro, la de un desconocido que habitaba su cuerpo. (comprender, literary pretérito indefinido for epiphany)
q_gram_c2_08_010.explanation: The pretérito indefinido 'comprendió' marks moment epiphany (anagnórisis) в literary narrative — sudden, completed act understanding который changes everything. The имперфект 'comprendía' would suggest gradual, ongoing understanding without dramatic rupture. Literary analysis distinguishes between these aspectual choices as deliberate narrative strategies.
q_gram_c2_08_010.conjugation_info: comprender (pretérito indefinido): comprendí, comprendiste, comprendió, comprendimos, comprendisteis, comprendieron

q_gram_c2_09_001.question: Estoy seguro ___ que vendrá mañana. (Выберите правильный preposition, или lack thereof)
q_gram_c2_09_001.explanation: 'Estar seguro de que' is correct construction (dequeísmo check: 'Estoy seguro DE algo' → 'de que' is required). Omitting 'de' (*'Estoy seguro que') является common error called queísmo — incorrect suppression preposition 'de' before 'que'. This is one most frequent errors even among educated native speakers.
q_gram_c2_09_001.hint: Test: 'Estoy seguro DE algo' → 'de' must be retained before 'que'

q_gram_c2_09_002.question: Me alegro ___ que hayas aprobado el examen. (Выберите правильный preposition)
q_gram_c2_09_002.explanation: 'Alegrarse de que' is correct (test: 'me alegro DE algo'). Saying *'me alegro que' is queísmo — error. Conversely, saying *'me alegro de de que' would be hypercorrection. The preposition 'de' is inherent к verb 'alegrarse de' и must be maintained before conjunction 'que'.
q_gram_c2_09_002.hint: Verb regime test: 'alegrarse DE algo' → 'de que' is обязательно

q_gram_c2_09_003.question: What error does sentence 'Pienso de que deberías estudiar más' contain?
q_gram_c2_09_003.correct: Dequeísmo: the incorrect insertion of 'de' before 'que' — it should be 'Pienso que deberías estudiar más'
wrong: Leísmo: incorrect use of an indirect object pronoun
Loísmo: incorrect use of a direct object pronoun
q_gram_c2_09_003.explanation: Dequeísmo is insertion 'de' before 'que' where it does не belong. Test: 'Pienso ALGO' (не *'pienso DE algo'), therefore 'pienso que' is correct и 'pienso de que' is dequeísmo. This error is stigmatized в formal Spanish и является hallmark diagnostic at C2 level.

q_gram_c2_09_004.question: Los estudiantes, ___ por la noticia, salieron del aula en silencio. (conmover, past participle agreeing with subject — correct concordance)
q_gram_c2_09_004.explanation: The past причастие в absolute participial clause must agree в gender и number с noun it modifies. 'Los estudiantes' is мужского рода множественного числа, поэтому 'conmovidos' is required. Using 'conmovido' (мужского рода единственного числа) would be concordance error (error de concordancia). Note: 'conmoviendo' (герундий) would create different construction entirely.
q_gram_c2_09_004.conjugation_info: conmover (past причастие): conmovido/a/os/as — agrees с noun в absolute constructions

q_gram_c2_09_005.question: Han habido muchos problemas este año. → Identify and correct the error.
q_gram_c2_09_005.explanation: 'Haber' as impersonal verb (meaning 'there is/являются') is ALWAYS third person единственного числа, regardless what follows. *'Han habido muchos problemas' is incorrect потому что 'problemas' is не subject — verb is impersonal. This is one most common errors among native speakers, especially в regions like Valencia и Latin America.
q_gram_c2_09_005.hint: Impersonal 'haber' is always единственного числа: ha habido, había, hubo, habrá

q_gram_c2_09_006.question: La carta ___ enviada ayer por el secretario. (ser, preterite passive — correct passive voice construction)
q_gram_c2_09_006.explanation: The passive voice с 'ser' uses pretérito indefinido 'fue' для completed past action с specified time ('ayer'). Using 'estuvo' (*'estuvo enviada') является common error — 'estar' + причастие describes resulting state, не action itself. 'La carta fue enviada' (action) vs. 'La carta estaba enviada' (resulting state) является crucial distinction.
q_gram_c2_09_006.conjugation_info: ser (pretérito indefinido): fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fuisteis, fueron

q_gram_c2_09_007.question: Llegó corriendo y ___ la puerta de un portazo. (identify correct construction: avoid improper gerund)
q_gram_c2_09_007.explanation: Using герундий к express result или subsequent action (*'Llegó cerrando la puerta') is incorrect в Spanish — герундий cannot express posteriority. The correct construction uses conjugated verb ('cerró') coordinated с 'y'. This misuse герундий (gerundio de posterioridad) is considered one most serious grammatical errors в formal Spanish.
q_gram_c2_09_007.hint: The Spanish герундий cannot express action который occurs after main verb

q_gram_c2_09_008.question: I am convinced that the project will succeed. (translate correctly, avoiding queísmo)
q_gram_c2_09_008.correct: Estoy convencido de que el proyecto tendrá éxito.
wrong: Estoy convencido que el proyecto tendrá éxito.
Estoy convencido en que el proyecto tendrá éxito.
Soy convencido de que el proyecto tendrá éxito.
q_gram_c2_09_008.explanation: 'Estar convencido DE que' requires preposition 'de' (test: 'convencido DE algo'). Omitting it (*'convencido que') is queísmo. Additionally, note 'estar convencido' (не *'ser convencido') — conviction является state (estar), не inherent characteristic (ser). Both errors являются diagnostic at C2 level.

q_gram_c2_09_009.question: La vieron y, ___ con ella, le entregaron el documento. (hablar, corrected gerund — simultaneous action)
q_gram_c2_09_009.explanation: The герундий IS correct when expressing action simultaneous с или immediately preceding main verb. 'Hablando con ella, le entregaron el documento' (while speaking с her, they handed her document) uses герундий для simultaneity, который is grammatically valid. This contrasts с prohibited герундий posteriority.
q_gram_c2_09_009.conjugation_info: Valid герундий uses: simultaneity (cantando, bailaba), manner (llegó corriendo), condition (estudiando más, aprobarás)

q_gram_c2_09_010.question: Habían muchas personas en la sala esperando su turno.
q_gram_c2_09_010.correct: There were many people in the room waiting for their turn. (Note: 'Habían' is grammatically incorrect in standard Spanish — it should be 'Había')
wrong: There had been many people in the room waiting for their turn.
Many people had the room waiting for their turn.
They had many people in the room who were waiting.
q_gram_c2_09_010.explanation: The impersonal verb 'haber' (existential: there is/являются) must always be conjugated в third person единственного числа: 'había' (не *'habían'). The множественного числа noun 'muchas personas' is direct object, NOT subject. This error is extremely widespread в spoken Spanish (especially в Latin America) но is unacceptable в formal/written C2-level Spanish.

q_gram_c2_10_001.question: María estudió toda la noche. ___ embargo, no aprobó el examen. (Выберите правильный discourse marker для concession/contrast)
q_gram_c2_10_001.explanation: 'Sin embargo' (however/nevertheless) является concessive discourse marker который introduces result contrary к what previous clause would lead one к expect. It functions as adversative connector maintaining cohesion between two propositions. In discourse analysis, it signals counter-argumentative relationship.
q_gram_c2_10_001.conjugation_info: Adversative/concessive markers: sin embargo, no obstante, con todo, ahora bien, aun así

q_gram_c2_10_002.question: La empresa anunció nuevas medidas. ___ incluyen la reducción de la jornada laboral. (Choose anaphoric pronoun который maintains cohesion)
q_gram_c2_10_002.explanation: 'Estas' (these) is correct anaphoric demonstrative потому что it refers back к 'nuevas medidas' just mentioned — most recently introduced referent. In discourse analysis, 'estas' creates near-distance anaphora (referencing what was just said), while 'aquellas' would suggest greater textual distance. This choice affects discourse cohesion.
q_gram_c2_10_002.hint: Near anaphora (just mentioned) = estas; distant anaphora = aquellas

q_gram_c2_10_003.question: El gobierno implementará un nuevo plan fiscal. ___: primero se revisarán los impuestos, luego se ajustarán las subvenciones. (Choose appropriate connector для introducing detailed specification)
q_gram_c2_10_003.explanation: 'A saber' (namely / к wit) является discourse marker который introduces detailed enumeration или specification what was previously mentioned. While 'es decir', 'o sea', и 'esto es' являются reformulative markers (they rephrase same idea), 'saber' specifically introduces breakdown into parts — it has particularizing function rather than reformulative one.
q_gram_c2_10_003.hint: Which marker introduces enumeration/specification rather than paraphrase?

q_gram_c2_10_004.question: In discourse analysis, what is the difference between anaphora and cataphora?
q_gram_c2_10_004.correct: Anaphora refers back to something previously mentioned in the text, while cataphora refers forward to something that will be mentioned later
wrong: Anaphora is a literary device of repetition, while cataphora is a grammatical error
Both refer to the same thing: backward reference in text
Anaphora is used in spoken language and cataphora only in written language
q_gram_c2_10_004.explanation: Anaphora (backward reference): 'Juan llegó. ÉL estaba cansado.' (él → Juan). Cataphora (forward reference): 'Lo que te voy decir es ESTO: no vuelvas.' (esto → no vuelvas). Both являются referential mechanisms который create textual cohesion. Mastering these concepts is essential для C2-level discourse analysis и academic writing в Spanish.

q_gram_c2_10_005.question: El proyecto fracasó. No obstante, los investigadores ___ valiosas lecciones de la experiencia. (extraer, pretérito indefinido — maintaining thematic progression)
q_gram_c2_10_005.explanation: 'No obstante' (nevertheless) introduces counter-argumentative clause. The pretérito indefinido 'extrajeron' maintains narrative past frame established by 'fracasó'. In discourse analysis, thematic progression requires tense consistency: both clauses share same temporal plane (completed past actions), creating coherent counter-argument.
q_gram_c2_10_005.conjugation_info: extraer (pretérito indefinido): extraje, extrajiste, extrajo, extrajimos, extrajisteis, extrajeron — irregular stem extraj-

q_gram_c2_10_006.question: Algunos expertos defienden la medida. ___, otros la consideran contraproducente. (Choose discourse marker для introducing opposing viewpoint)
q_gram_c2_10_006.explanation: 'En cambio' (на other рука / в contrast) является contrastive discourse marker который introduces opposing perspective. 'Además' (moreover) is additive; 'por lo tanto' (therefore) is consecutive; 'asimismo' (likewise) is additive. In discourse analysis, choosing correct marker determines argumentative relationship between propositions.
q_gram_c2_10_006.hint: The second clause presents opposing view — который marker signals contrast?

q_gram_c2_10_007.question: What I want к emphasize is following: information structure determines how message is received. (translate preserving cataphoric structure)
q_gram_c2_10_007.correct: Lo que quiero recalcar es lo siguiente: la estructura informativa determina cómo se recibe el mensaje.
wrong: Quiero recalcar que la estructura informativa determina cómo se recibe el mensaje.
Lo siguiente es lo que quiero recalcar: la estructura informativa determina cómo el mensaje se recibe.
Lo que quiero recalcar es esto, la estructura informativa determina cómo se recibe el mensaje.
q_gram_c2_10_007.explanation: The cataphoric construction 'lo que quiero recalcar es lo siguiente:' (what I want к emphasize is following:) creates anticipation и foregrounds information который follows colon. In discourse analysis, это является focusing device (mecanismo de focalización). The alternative without cataphora ('quiero recalcar que...') is grammatically correct но loses emphatic information structure.

q_gram_c2_10_008.question: La economía creció un 3%. ___ se redujo la tasa de desempleo. (Choose consecutive discourse marker)
q_gram_c2_10_008.explanation: 'En consecuencia' (consequently/as result) является consecutive discourse marker который establishes cause-effect relationship: economic growth → reduced unemployment. The other options являются adversative/contrastive, который would contradict logical relationship between two propositions. Discourse coherence requires который connectors match logical relationship between clauses.
q_gram_c2_10_008.hint: The second clause является result first — который marker signals consequence?

q_gram_c2_10_009.question: En primer lugar, se analizarán los datos. A continuación, se presentarán los resultados. Por último, se extraerán las conclusiones.
q_gram_c2_10_009.correct: First, the data will be analyzed. Next, the results will be presented. Finally, the conclusions will be drawn.
wrong: In the first place, the data is analyzed. Following that, results are presented. At last, conclusions are extracted.
Firstly, they will analyze data. Then, they present results. Lastly, they extract conclusions.
First of all, the data was analyzed. Afterwards, the results were presented. In the end, the conclusions were drawn.
q_gram_c2_10_009.explanation: The Spanish text uses ordering discourse markers ('en primer lugar', 'continuación', 'por último') с passive 'se' constructions в будущее время, creating impersonal academic register. The correct translation maintains: (1) sequential markers, (2) passive voice, и (3) будущее время consistency. Mixing tenses или voices, as wrong answers do, breaks discourse coherence.

q_gram_c2_10_010.question: Dicho ___, pasemos al siguiente punto del orden del día. (Choose anaphoric причастие который summarizes everything previously stated)
q_gram_c2_10_010.explanation: The expression 'dicho esto' (having said это / который said) is anaphoric discourse marker который encapsulates everything previously stated и signals transition к новый topic. 'Esto' refers к immediately preceding discourse (near reference). 'Dicho eso' would suggest more distance; 'dicho aquello' implies remote reference. In discourse analysis, 'dicho esto' functions as both summarizing anaphor и transitional marker.
q_gram_c2_10_010.conjugation_info: Summarizing anaphoric expressions: dicho esto, en vista de lo anterior, teniendo en cuenta lo expuesto, la luz de lo dicho

q_gram_c2_11_001.question: In Spanish, English phrase 'I am hungry' becomes 'Tengo ___'. What translation technique is applied here?
q_gram_c2_11_001.explanation: Spanish uses 'tener hambre' (к have hunger) rather than 'estar hambriento' (к be hungry). This is example transposition, where grammatical structure shifts от adjective к noun. The correct fill is 'hambre' (hunger), noun форма.
q_gram_c2_11_001.hint: Spanish expresses states being с 'tener + noun' rather than 'ser/estar + adjective'

q_gram_c2_11_002.question: La directora ___ una rueda de prensa para desmentir los rumores. (English source: 'The director held a press conference to deny the rumors.')
q_gram_c2_11_002.explanation: English 'к hold press conference' translates к 'convocar una rueda de prensa' в Spanish, не literal 'sostener' или 'tener'. This is modulation: perspective shifts от 'holding' (maintaining) к 'convening' (calling together). 'Convocó' captures correct Spanish collocation.
q_gram_c2_11_002.hint: Think about Spanish verb который означает 'к call/convene' rather than literally translating 'held'

q_gram_c2_11_003.question: What translation technique используется when 'It's raining cats и dogs' becomes 'Llueve cántaros' в Spanish?
q_gram_c2_11_003.correct: Equivalence — replacing one idiom with a culturally equivalent idiom that conveys the same meaning through a different image
wrong: Literal translation — both idioms use animal imagery to convey heavy rain
Transposition — the grammatical category of the key elements changes during translation
Calque — the Spanish expression is a word-for-word structural borrowing from English
q_gram_c2_11_003.explanation: Equivalence replaces entire expression с functionally equivalent one в target language. 'Cats и dogs' и 'cántaros' (в pitchers/jugs) use completely different images но convey same meaning: extremely heavy rain. The cultural referent changes entirely.

q_gram_c2_11_004.question: A él le ___ mucho los deportes acuáticos. (English source: 'He really likes water sports.' — gustar, present indicative)
q_gram_c2_11_004.explanation: English 'he likes' becomes 'le gustan' в Spanish, complete structural reversal. The English subject ('he') becomes indirect object ('le'), и English object ('water sports') becomes grammatical subject, requiring third person множественного числа 'gustan' к agree с 'los deportes acuáticos'.
q_gram_c2_11_004.conjugation_info: gustar (present): gusto, gustas, gusta, gustamos, gustáis, gustan — agrees с thing liked, не person

q_gram_c2_11_005.question: El investigador ___ que los resultados preliminares confirman la hipótesis. (English source: 'The researcher pointed out that the preliminary results confirm the hypothesis.')
q_gram_c2_11_005.explanation: English 'pointed out' translates as 'señaló' в academic contexts, maintaining indicative в subordinate clause потому что content is presented as factual. 'Apuntó' could work colloquially но 'señaló' is standard academic translation. 'Indicó fuera' incorrectly introduces сослагательное наклонение where none is needed.
q_gram_c2_11_005.hint: Choose standard reporting verb used в Spanish academic writing

q_gram_c2_11_006.question: Nos ___ muy bien en la fiesta. (English source: 'We had a great time at the party.' — pasárselo, pretérito indefinido, nosotros)
q_gram_c2_11_006.explanation: English 'к have great time' translates as 'pasárselo bien' в Spanish. The pronoun 'lo' is proclitic (placed before conjugated verb), giving 'nos lo pasamos'. However, в many dialects reflexive is dropped и standard форма is 'lo pasamos muy bien'. The претерит используется для completed event.
q_gram_c2_11_006.conjugation_info: pasárselo (pretérito indefinido): me lo pasé, te lo pasaste, se lo pasó, nos lo pasamos, os lo pasasteis, se lo pasaron

q_gram_c2_11_007.question: El acuerdo fue ___ por ambas partes tras meses de negociación. (English source: 'The agreement was entered into by both parties after months of negotiation.')
q_gram_c2_11_007.explanation: English 'к enter into agreement' cannot be literally translated as 'entrar en un acuerdo'. Spanish uses 'suscribir un acuerdo' (к subscribe/sign agreement). This is example modulation where viewpoint shifts от 'entering' к 'signing/subscribing'.
q_gram_c2_11_007.hint: Think about formal Spanish legal verb meaning 'к sign/ratify'

q_gram_c2_11_008.question: She made it clear that she would not tolerate any more delays.
q_gram_c2_11_008.correct: Dejó bien claro que no toleraría más retrasos.
wrong: Ella hizo claro que ella no toleraría ninguno más retrasos.
Ella la hizo clara que no toleraba más retardos.
Se hizo claro que no toleraría más demoras.
q_gram_c2_11_008.explanation: English 'she made it clear' translates к 'dejó bien claro' (left well clear), не literal 'hizo claro'. This involves modulation (changing 'made' к 'left') и transposition (adverb 'well' replaces pronoun 'it'). The subject pronoun 'ella' is обычно omitted в Spanish.

q_gram_c2_11_009.question: Es imprescindible que se ___ en cuenta todos los factores antes de tomar una decisión. (English source: 'All factors must be taken into account before making a decision.' — tener, present subjunctive, impersonal)
q_gram_c2_11_009.explanation: English 'must be taken into account' becomes 'es imprescindible que se tengan en cuenta' в Spanish. The impersonal passive construction с 'se' replaces English passive voice, и сослагательное наклонение is triggered by 'es imprescindible que'. The verb agrees с 'todos los factores' (множественного числа).
q_gram_c2_11_009.conjugation_info: tener (present сослагательное наклонение): tenga, tengas, tenga, tengamos, tengáis, tengan

q_gram_c2_11_010.question: No cabe duda de que la globalización ha traído consigo tanto ventajas como inconvenientes que habrán de abordarse con rigor.
q_gram_c2_11_010.correct: There is no doubt that globalization has brought with it both advantages and disadvantages that will need to be addressed rigorously.
wrong: It does not fit doubt that globalization has brought with it advantages like inconveniences that will have to be approached with rigor.
There is no room for doubt that the globalization brought advantages as well as inconveniences that should be addressed rigorously.
Undoubtedly globalization carries advantages and disadvantages that must have been addressed with strictness.
q_gram_c2_11_010.explanation: 'No cabe duda' (lit. 'no doubt fits') is idiomatic expression meaning 'there is no doubt'. 'Ha traído consigo' означает 'has brought с it'. 'Habrán de abordarse' является formal periphrasis (haber de + инфинитив) meaning 'will need к be addressed'. 'Con rigor' = 'rigorously'.

q_gram_c2_12_001.question: A María le ___ en gracia el comentario del profesor. (caer, pretérito indefinido)
q_gram_c2_12_001.explanation: 'Caerle en gracia alguien' является fixed idiomatic structure meaning 'к amuse someone' или 'к find something funny'. It follows gustar-type construction с indirect object. The претерит 'cayó' указывает на completed past event.
q_gram_c2_12_001.conjugation_info: caer (pretérito indefinido): caí, caíste, cayó, caímos, caísteis, cayeron

q_gram_c2_12_002.question: El proyecto se fue ___ pique cuando retiraron la financiación.
q_gram_c2_12_002.explanation: 'Irse pique' является fixed idiomatic expression meaning 'к fall through / к collapse / к sink'. It comes от nautical terminology (ship sinking). The preposition 'a' is fixed element это collocation и cannot be substituted.
q_gram_c2_12_002.hint: This nautical idiom literally означает 'к go к bottom'

q_gram_c2_12_003.question: No me ___ ni fu ni fa lo que diga la prensa sobre el escándalo.
q_gram_c2_12_003.explanation: 'No irle alguien ni fu ni fa' is idiomatic expression meaning 'к не care one way или another / к be indifferent'. The fixed verb is 'ir' в gustar-type construction. Though 'dar igual' expresses similar meaning, это particular idiom requires 'ir'.
q_gram_c2_12_003.hint: The expression uses verb motion в gustar-type construction

q_gram_c2_12_004.question: What does idiomatic structure 'dar en el clavo' mean?
q_gram_c2_12_004.correct: To hit the nail on the head — to be exactly right about something
wrong: To give someone a nail — to cause someone pain
To hammer home a point — to repeat an argument insistently
To nail down a deal — to finalize an agreement
q_gram_c2_12_004.explanation: 'Dar en el clavo' literally означает 'к hit nail' и idiomatically означает 'к be exactly right / к hit nail на head'. This is one those rare cases where Spanish и English share similar idiomatic image, though structure differs ('dar en' vs. 'hit на').

q_gram_c2_12_005.question: Los vecinos ___ gato por liebre cuando compraron esa casa supuestamente renovada. (dar, pretérito indefinido, passive 'les dieron')
q_gram_c2_12_005.explanation: 'Dar gato por liebre' (к give кошка для hare) означает 'к deceive / к rip someone off'. The претерит 'dieron' используется потому что deception was completed past action. The indirect object 'les' (к them/neighbors) is required by это gustar-type construction.
q_gram_c2_12_005.conjugation_info: dar (pretérito indefinido): di, diste, dio, dimos, disteis, dieron

q_gram_c2_12_006.question: El político ___ por las ramas durante toda la entrevista sin responder a ninguna pregunta directa.
q_gram_c2_12_006.explanation: 'Andarse por las ramas' (к walk through branches) is idiomatic expression meaning 'к beat around bush'. The fixed verb is 'andarse' (reflexive). The претерит 'se anduvo' uses irregular stem anduv-, который is essential для это idiom.
q_gram_c2_12_006.hint: The idiom uses reflexive verb meaning 'к walk' с irregular претерит stem

q_gram_c2_12_007.question: She let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
q_gram_c2_12_007.correct: Se fue de la lengua sobre la fiesta sorpresa.
wrong: Dejó el gato fuera de la bolsa sobre la fiesta sorpresa.
Soltó el gato de la bolsa acerca de la fiesta sorpresa.
Se le escapó el gato de la bolsa sobre la fiesta sorpresa.
q_gram_c2_12_007.explanation: English 'к let кошка out bag' (к reveal secret) corresponds к Spanish idiom 'irse de la lengua' (к slip tongue). This is equivalence: cultural image changes entirely (кошка/bag vs. tongue), но meaning is preserved. A literal translation would be nonsensical.

q_gram_c2_12_008.question: A pesar de sus esfuerzos, el negocio no ___ a flote y tuvieron que cerrar.
q_gram_c2_12_008.explanation: 'Salir flote' (к come afloat) означает 'к get back на one's feet / к recover'. The претерит 'salió' combined с negation 'no' указывает на business failed к recover. The idiom is fixed — 'flotar' (к float) cannot replace 'salir flote'.
q_gram_c2_12_008.hint: The idiom uses verb meaning 'к exit/come out' с 'flote'

q_gram_c2_12_009.question: Le echaron un buen rapapolvo al director por haber autorizado el gasto sin consultar a la junta.
q_gram_c2_12_009.correct: The director got a good telling-off for having authorized the expense without consulting the board.
wrong: They threw a good scrubbing at the director for authorizing the expense without consulting the meeting.
They poured a rapapolvo on the director because he had authorized the spending without consulting the board.
The director received a reprimand for having allowed the expense without discussing with the committee.
q_gram_c2_12_009.explanation: 'Echar un rapapolvo' является colloquial idiomatic expression meaning 'к give someone telling-off / dressing-down'. 'Rapapolvo' has no literal translation и exists only within это idiom. 'La junta' here означает 'board ( directors)', не 'meeting'.

q_gram_c2_12_010.question: Después de tantos años de trabajo, por fin ___ las de ganar en la negociación con la empresa. (llevar, pretérito indefinido, él/ella form)
q_gram_c2_12_010.explanation: 'Llevar las de ganar' является fixed idiomatic structure meaning 'к have upper рука / к be в winning position'. The verb 'llevar' cannot be replaced by 'tener' или 'ganar' в это construction. The претерит 'llevó' указывает на advantage was achieved at specific past moment.
q_gram_c2_12_010.conjugation_info: llevar (pretérito indefinido): llevé, llevaste, llevó, llevamos, llevasteis, llevaron

q_gram_c2_13_001.question: Vi al hombre con el ___ . (Which word resolves the ambiguity of 'I saw the man with the telescope'?)
q_gram_c2_13_001.explanation: The sentence 'Vi al hombre con el telescopio' is structurally ambiguous: 'con el telescopio' can modify 'vi' (I saw using telescope) или 'al hombre' (man who had telescope). This is classic PP-attachment ambiguity. The fill-в itself is unambiguous — 'telescopio' is instrument — но sentence structure remains ambiguous.
q_gram_c2_13_001.hint: The prepositional phrase 'con el telescopio' can attach к two different elements
