q_gram_c2_13_002.question: Cada estudiante entregó ___ trabajo a su profesor. (possessive that creates ambiguity)
q_gram_c2_13_002.explanation: 'Su' creates referential ambiguity: 'su trabajo' could mean 'his/her own work' или 'his/her (someone else's) work', и 'su profesor' could refer к each student's own professor или someone else's. This possessive ambiguity is inherent в Spanish потому что 'su' covers his/her/its/your/their.

q_gram_c2_13_003.question: What type ambiguity does sentence 'Juan le dijo Pedro que lo ascendieron' contain?
q_gram_c2_13_003.correct: Referential ambiguity — 'lo' could refer to either Juan or Pedro, making it unclear who was promoted
wrong: Lexical ambiguity — the word 'ascendieron' has multiple dictionary meanings
Structural ambiguity — the subordinate clause can attach to different parts of the sentence
Pragmatic ambiguity — the sentence is ambiguous only in certain cultural contexts
q_gram_c2_13_003.explanation: In 'Juan le dijo Pedro que lo ascendieron', pronoun 'lo' could refer к either Juan или Pedro. Did Juan tell Pedro который Juan himself was promoted, или который Pedro was promoted? This is referential (или pronominal) ambiguity, common в Spanish due к flexibility pronoun reference.

q_gram_c2_13_004.question: No todos los estudiantes ___ a la reunión. (asistir, pretérito indefinido — this sentence means something different from 'Todos los estudiantes no asistieron')
q_gram_c2_13_004.explanation: Scope ambiguity arises с quantifiers и negation. 'No todos asistieron' (не все attended = some did, some didn't) differs от 'Todos no asistieron' (все them didn't attend = none attended). The претерит 'asistieron' используется для completed past event.
q_gram_c2_13_004.conjugation_info: asistir (pretérito indefinido): asistí, asististe, asistió, asistimos, asististeis, asistieron

q_gram_c2_13_005.question: La decisión del comité ___ ejecutivo provocó controversia. (Choose word который shows how punctuation/structure resolves ambiguity.)
q_gram_c2_13_005.explanation: 'La decisión del comité más ejecutivo' is ambiguous: does 'más ejecutivo' modify 'comité' (most executive committee) или 'la decisión' (most executive decision committee)? Inserting 'más' exposes structural ambiguity adjective attachment в Spanish nominal groups.
q_gram_c2_13_005.hint: Consider how comparative adjective can modify either committee или decision

q_gram_c2_13_006.question: Los padres de los alumnos que ___ molestos presentaron una queja formal. (estar, pretérito imperfecto — who was upset: the parents or the students?)
q_gram_c2_13_006.explanation: This sentence contains relative clause attachment ambiguity: 'que estaban molestos' could modify 'los padres' (parents who were upset) или 'los alumnos' (parents students who were upset). The имперфект 'estaban' describes ongoing state. Only context или rephrasing can resolve ambiguity.
q_gram_c2_13_006.conjugation_info: estar (pretérito imperfecto): estaba, estabas, estaba, estábamos, estabais, estaban

q_gram_c2_13_007.question: La profesora habló con ___ estudiante en su despacho. (article that preserves maximum ambiguity)
q_gram_c2_13_007.explanation: 'La profesora habló con el estudiante en su despacho' contains double ambiguity: (1) 'su despacho' could be professor's office или student's office (possessive ambiguity), и (2) 'en su despacho' could modify 'habló' (where conversation took place) или 'el estudiante' (student who is в office). The определённый артикль 'el' maximizes это ambiguity.

q_gram_c2_13_008.question: I told my brother that his wife called him. (Translate to preserve the pronominal ambiguity inherent in the Spanish version.)
q_gram_c2_13_008.correct: Le dije a mi hermano que su esposa lo llamó.
wrong: Dije a mi hermano que la esposa de él lo llamó.
Le dije a mi hermano que su mujer le había llamado.
Le conté a mi hermano que su esposa lo había telefoneado.
q_gram_c2_13_008.explanation: The translation 'Le dije mi hermano que su esposa lo llamó' preserves referential ambiguity 'su' (his/my?) и 'lo' (him = my brother? или someone else?). Using 'la esposa de él' would disambiguate possessive, losing natural ambiguity. The претерит 'llamó' matches simple past tense.

q_gram_c2_13_009.question: María no ___ que todos los candidatos fueran competentes. (creer, pretérito imperfecto — this creates scope ambiguity between negation and the universal quantifier)
q_gram_c2_13_009.explanation: 'María no creía que todos los candidatos fueran competentes' has scope ambiguity: (1) María believed не все were competent (partial negation: some were, some weren't), или (2) María didn't hold belief который все were competent (she had no opinion). The имперфект 'creía' describes her ongoing state belief, и сослагательное наклонение 'fueran' is triggered by negated belief verb.
q_gram_c2_13_009.conjugation_info: creer (pretérito imperfecto): creía, creías, creía, creíamos, creíais, creían

q_gram_c2_13_010.question: El policía detuvo al sospechoso en su coche.
q_gram_c2_13_010.correct: The police officer detained the suspect in his car. (Ambiguous: whose car — the officer's or the suspect's?)
wrong: The police officer stopped the suspect who was in the car. (Unambiguous: the suspect was in the car.)
The police officer was detained by the suspect in a car. (Passive reading: the suspect detained the officer.)
The officer stopped his own suspect inside the vehicle. (Unambiguous: the officer's own car.)
q_gram_c2_13_010.explanation: 'En su coche' creates possessive ambiguity: 'su' could refer к officer's car или suspect's car. Additionally, 'en su coche' could be adverbial modifier 'detuvo' (where arrest happened) или postmodifier 'al sospechoso' (suspect who was в car). The correct translation preserves both layers ambiguity.

q_gram_c2_14_001.question: En el presente estudio se ___ las variables que inciden en el rendimiento académico. (analizar, present indicative, impersonal 'se')
q_gram_c2_14_001.explanation: Academic Spanish uses impersonal 'se' constructions к maintain objectivity. Since 'las variables' is множественного числа, verb must agree: 'se analizan las variables'. The настоящее время is standard для describing scope и methodology current study.
q_gram_c2_14_001.conjugation_info: analizar (present): analizo, analizas, analiza, analizamos, analizáis, analizan

q_gram_c2_14_002.question: Los datos ___ recopilados mediante una encuesta diseñada ad hoc para esta investigación.
q_gram_c2_14_002.explanation: Academic writing uses passive voice с 'ser + past причастие' к emphasize process over agent. 'Los datos fueron recopilados' (data were collected) uses претерит passive потому что data collection was completed past action. 'Estuvieron recopilados' would incorrectly describe resulting state rather than action.
q_gram_c2_14_002.hint: Use претерит 'ser' к форма passive voice для completed past action

q_gram_c2_14_003.question: Cabe ___ que los resultados podrían verse afectados por el tamaño reducido de la muestra.
q_gram_c2_14_003.explanation: 'Cabe señalar que...' (it should be noted который / it is worth pointing out который) является fixed hedging expression в academic Spanish. 'Caber' + инфинитив is impersonal construction used к introduce observations или caveats. Only инфинитив форма follows 'cabe' в это structure.
q_gram_c2_14_003.hint: The verb 'caber' takes инфинитив complement в это fixed academic expression

q_gram_c2_14_004.question: What is function nominalization в academic Spanish, as в 'la obtención de resultados' instead 'obtener resultados'?
q_gram_c2_14_004.correct: It converts verbs into nouns to create more formal, impersonal, and information-dense prose typical of scientific writing
wrong: It simplifies complex ideas by replacing long verb phrases with shorter noun equivalents
It is primarily a stylistic choice with no functional difference from using verb phrases
It makes texts more accessible to non-specialist readers by eliminating technical verb forms
q_gram_c2_14_004.explanation: Nominalization (turning verbs into nouns: obtener → la obtención) является hallmark academic register в Spanish. It serves multiple functions: increasing information density, enabling impersonal expression, allowing noun phrases к serve as grammatical subjects, и creating formal tone expected в scholarly writing.

q_gram_c2_14_005.question: Los resultados ___ sugerir que existe una correlación significativa entre ambas variables. (parecer, present indicative, hedging)
q_gram_c2_14_005.explanation: 'Parecer + инфинитив' является key hedging device в academic Spanish, softening claims к avoid categorical assertions. 'Los resultados parecen sugerir' (results seem к suggest) is doubly hedged — both 'parecen' и 'sugerir' attenuate claim. The множественного числа 'parecen' agrees с 'los resultados'.
q_gram_c2_14_005.conjugation_info: parecer (present): parezco, pareces, parece, parecemos, parecéis, parecen

q_gram_c2_14_006.question: A partir de los hallazgos, se ___ la necesidad de ampliar el estudio a una población más diversa.
q_gram_c2_14_006.explanation: 'Se constata la necesidad' uses impersonal passive 'se' с единственного числа verb потому что 'la necesidad' is единственного числа. 'Constatar' (к verify/establish) является formal academic verb. The настоящее время conveys conclusion as current finding derived от research.
q_gram_c2_14_006.hint: The verb must agree с единственного числа subject 'la necesidad'

q_gram_c2_14_007.question: Further research is needed to determine the long-term effects of this intervention.
q_gram_c2_14_007.correct: Se requiere investigación adicional para determinar los efectos a largo plazo de esta intervención.
wrong: Más investigación es necesitada para determinar los efectos a largo plazo de esta intervención.
Necesitamos más investigación para determinar los efectos de largo plazo de esta intervención.
Es necesario que se investigue más para que se determinen los efectos a largo tiempo de esta intervención.
q_gram_c2_14_007.explanation: Academic Spanish avoids English passive 'is needed' и uses 'se requiere' (impersonal se). 'Investigación adicional' is preferred over 'más investigación' в formal registers. 'A largo plazo' is correct fixed expression для 'long-term', не 'de largo plazo' или 'largo tiempo'.

q_gram_c2_14_008.question: Tal y como se ___ en la sección anterior, las limitaciones metodológicas deben tenerse en cuenta al interpretar estos datos.
q_gram_c2_14_008.explanation: 'Tal y como se mencionó en la sección anterior' (as was mentioned в previous section) uses impersonal 'se' с претерит к refer к specific earlier point в text. The претерит is preferred here потому что mention occurred at definite point, unlike имперфект который would imply ongoing или repeated action.
q_gram_c2_14_008.hint: Use претерит для specific past reference within text

q_gram_c2_14_009.question: No se han hallado diferencias estadísticamente significativas entre los grupos experimentales y el grupo de control.
q_gram_c2_14_009.correct: No statistically significant differences have been found between the experimental groups and the control group.
wrong: Statistically significant differences have not been found between the groups of experiment and the group of control.
There were no differences of statistical significance between the experimental groups and the controlling group.
Significant statistical differences were not encountered between the experimental and the control groups.
q_gram_c2_14_009.explanation: 'Se han hallado' (present perfect с impersonal 'se') translates к passive 'have been found'. 'Estadísticamente significativas' является fixed academic collocation meaning 'statistically significant'. 'Grupo de control' = 'control group' (не 'controlling group').

q_gram_c2_14_010.question: Sería conveniente que futuras investigaciones ___ estas variables con una muestra más amplia. (abordar, imperfect subjunctive, formal recommendation)
q_gram_c2_14_010.explanation: 'Sería conveniente que' (it would be advisable который) triggers имперфект сослагательное наклонение потому что main clause is в условное наклонение. 'Abordaran' is -ra форма имперфект сослагательное наклонение. In academic writing, это structure используется для recommendations. Note: 'abordasen' is also grammatically valid но -ra форма is standard в academic prose.
q_gram_c2_14_010.conjugation_info: abordar (имперфект сослагательное наклонение): abordara, abordaras, abordara, abordáramos, abordarais, abordaran

q_gram_c2_15_001.question: Si yo ___ tú, no aceptaría esa oferta. (ser, imperfect subjunctive — a basic conditional structure reviewed at mastery level)
q_gram_c2_15_001.explanation: 'Si yo fuera tú' (if I were you) uses имперфект сослагательное наклонение в si-clause present contrary-к-fact условное наклонение. This is one most fundamental structures в Spanish, first encountered at B1-B2 но requiring complete mastery at C2. The условное наклонение 'aceptaría' follows в main clause.
q_gram_c2_15_001.hint: Contrary-к-fact conditionals require имперфект сослагательное наклонение в si-clause

q_gram_c2_15_002.question: Habiéndose ___ todas las pruebas, el juez dictó sentencia. (presentar, past participle in absolute participial clause)
q_gram_c2_15_002.explanation: The absolute participial clause 'habiéndose presentado todas las pruebas' (все evidence having been presented) uses compound герундий: habiendo + past причастие. With reflexive 'se', it becomes 'habiéndose presentado'. This is advanced literary construction который compresses temporal subordinate clause.

q_gram_c2_15_003.question: What is difference between 'ser aburrido' и 'estar aburrido'?
q_gram_c2_15_003.correct: 'Ser aburrido' means 'to be boring' (inherent quality), while 'estar aburrido' means 'to be bored' (temporary state)
wrong: Both mean 'to be bored' but 'ser' is more formal than 'estar'
'Ser aburrido' means 'to be bored' and 'estar aburrido' means 'to be boring'
'Ser aburrido' is used for people and 'estar aburrido' is used for things
q_gram_c2_15_003.explanation: The ser/estar distinction с adjectives is fundamental. With 'aburrido': ser describes inherent characteristic (Juan es aburrido = Juan является скучный person), while estar describes state или condition (Juan está aburrido = Juan is bored right now). This A2-level concept must be fully mastered by C2.

q_gram_c2_15_004.question: A no ser que se ___ medidas urgentes, la crisis se agravará irreversiblemente. (tomar, present subjunctive)
q_gram_c2_15_004.explanation: 'A no ser que' (unless) always triggers сослагательное наклонение. Since main clause uses future ('se agravará'), subordinate clause takes present сослагательное наклонение 'tomen'. The impersonal 'se' с множественного числа 'medidas' requires множественного числа форма. This tests mastery across сослагательное наклонение triggers, tense sequencing, и impersonal constructions.
q_gram_c2_15_004.conjugation_info: tomar (present сослагательное наклонение): tome, tomes, tome, tomemos, toméis, tomen

q_gram_c2_15_005.question: El informe, ___ conclusiones fueron cuestionadas por varios expertos, ha sido revisado por completo.
q_gram_c2_15_005.explanation: 'Cuyas' is женского рода множественного числа relative possessive pronoun, agreeing с 'conclusiones' (женского рода множественного числа), не с 'el informe' (мужского рода). 'Cuyo/a/os/as' agrees с thing possessed, не possessor. 'Que sus' is ungrammatical в standard Spanish relative clauses.
q_gram_c2_15_005.hint: The relative possessive must agree в gender и number с possessed noun

q_gram_c2_15_006.question: De haberlo ___ antes, habríamos tomado otra decisión. (saber, past participle — mixed conditional with compound infinitive)
q_gram_c2_15_006.explanation: 'De haberlo sabido' (had we known it) является compressed условное наклонение structure equivalent к 'Si lo hubiéramos sabido'. The compound инфинитив 'haber + past причастие' replaces full si-clause. This является C1-C2 construction который combines knowledge conditionals, инфинитив clauses, и clitic placement.
q_gram_c2_15_006.conjugation_info: saber (past причастие): sabido; compound инфинитив: haber sabido

q_gram_c2_15_007.question: Sea ___ sea el resultado, aceptaremos la decisión del tribunal.
q_gram_c2_15_007.explanation: 'Sea cual sea' (whatever/whichever... may be) является fixed concessive construction using duplicated present сослагательное наклонение 'ser'. The interrogative pronoun 'cual' is only correct option в это structure. This formula используется across все registers к express indifference к outcome.

q_gram_c2_15_008.question: Had it not been for your help, we would not have succeeded.
q_gram_c2_15_008.correct: De no haber sido por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
wrong: Si no hubiera sido por tu ayuda, no tuviéramos éxito.
Si no fuera por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
De no ser por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
q_gram_c2_15_008.explanation: 'Had it не been для' requires past counterfactual: 'De no haber sido por' (compound инфинитив construction). 'De no ser por' would mean 'were it не для' (present counterfactual). The main clause uses условное наклонение perfect 'habríamos tenido éxito' (would have succeeded).

q_gram_c2_15_009.question: Por mucho que se lo ___ , nunca nos hizo caso. (repetir, imperfect subjunctive, nosotros form — concessive clause with quantifier)
q_gram_c2_15_009.explanation: 'Por mucho que' (no matter how much) triggers сослагательное наклонение. The имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'repitiéramos' is required потому что main clause is в претерит ('hizo'). Note stem change: repetir → repit- в сослагательное наклонение (от third person претерит stem 'repitió'). The clitic 'se lo' precedes conjugated verb.
q_gram_c2_15_009.conjugation_info: repetir (имперфект сослагательное наклонение): repitiera, repitieras, repitiera, repitiéramos, repitierais, repitieran

q_gram_c2_15_010.question: Dicho sea de paso, no es la primera vez que se incumple el protocolo establecido, lo cual pone en entredicho la credibilidad de la institución.
q_gram_c2_15_010.correct: Incidentally, it is not the first time that the established protocol has been breached, which calls into question the institution's credibility.
wrong: Said in passing, it is not the first time they don't comply with the established protocol, which puts in between-said the credibility of the institution.
By the way, it is not the first time that the established protocol is unfulfilled, the which puts into question the credibility of the institution.
That said in passing, this is not the first time the protocol was not complied with, which casts doubt on the institution's credibility.
q_gram_c2_15_010.explanation: 'Dicho sea de paso' является fixed parenthetical expression meaning 'incidentally / by way'. 'Se incumple' (impersonal se + present) translates as 'has been breached' к capture resultative meaning. 'Poner en entredicho' is idiom meaning 'к call into question / к undermine'. This sentence tests mastery multiple advanced structures simultaneously.
